name: 4plebs
description: Archive site for 4chan boards that preserves posts and threads from various boards, allowing users to search through historical content that would otherwise be lost due to 4chan's ephemeral nature.

name: 8chan
description: Anonymous imageboard platform created as an alternative to 4chan, featuring user-created boards with minimal moderation. Known for hosting controversial content and being associated with various internet subcultures.

name: Adult Swim
description: Late-night programming block on Cartoon Network featuring adult-oriented animated series, experimental shows, and alternative comedy. Known for its surreal humor and cult following among internet communities.

name: JustPaste.it
description: Simple anonymous text sharing service that allows users to quickly paste and share text content without registration. Often used for sharing code snippets, messages, or documents temporarily.

name: Mail
description: Traditional email communication platform used for private correspondence, newsletters, and digital communication. Remains a primary method for formal and personal online communication.

name: Anime News Network
description: Comprehensive news and information website covering anime, manga, and Japanese pop culture. Features reviews, industry news, release schedules, and an extensive database of anime and manga titles.

name: AnimeSuki
description: Long-running anime discussion forum and community where fans discuss series, share recommendations, and engage in detailed analysis of anime and manga. Known for its dedicated fanbase and in-depth discussions.

name: BadMovies
description: Specialized forum dedicated to discussing B-movies, cult films, and so-bad-they're-good cinema. Community of film enthusiasts who celebrate low-budget and unconventional movies.

name: Bluelight
description: Harm reduction forum focused on drug safety, education, and support. Provides evidence-based information about substances and promotes safer use practices within a supportive community environment.

name: BluWiki
description: Collaborative wiki platform that allowed users to create and share content on various topics. Was a popular alternative to Wikipedia for more specialized or niche content before its closure.

name: Breitbart
description: Conservative news and opinion website known for its right-wing political commentary and controversial reporting. Influential in conservative media circles and associated with populist political movements.

name: Criterion
description: Prestigious film collection and discussion platform focused on classic, arthouse, and important cinema. The Criterion Collection is renowned for its high-quality film restorations and scholarly approach to cinema.

name: Daily Kos
description: Progressive political blog and community platform featuring liberal commentary, political analysis, and grassroots activism. Known for its active user base and influence in Democratic politics.

name: DailyKos
description: Alternative spelling of Daily Kos - progressive political blog and community platform featuring liberal commentary, political analysis, and grassroots activism coordination.

name: Daily Stormer
description: Far-right extremist website and forum promoting white supremacist ideology and neo-Nazi content. Known for spreading hate speech and conspiracy theories, frequently banned from mainstream platforms.

name: DeviantArt
description: Large online art community and platform where artists share digital artwork, photography, literature, and other creative content. Features galleries, critiques, and social networking for creative individuals.

name: DigitPress
description: Specialized video game collecting and discussion forum focused on retro gaming, rare games, and gaming memorabilia. Community of collectors and enthusiasts sharing knowledge about game values and history.

name: Disqus
description: Widely-used comment system and discussion platform that websites integrate to enable user comments and discussions. Provides moderation tools and social features for online communities.

name: E-mail
description: Electronic mail communication system that remains fundamental to internet communication. Used for everything from personal correspondence to business communications and automated notifications.

name: Facebook
description: Major social networking platform connecting billions of users worldwide. Features personal profiles, groups, pages, messaging, and content sharing. Central to modern social media and online identity.

name: FilmBoards
description: Movie discussion forum and community where film enthusiasts analyze movies, share reviews, and engage in detailed discussions about cinema, directors, and film theory.

name: IMDb
description: Internet Movie Database - the world's most comprehensive source for movie, TV, and celebrity information. Features ratings, reviews, trivia, and detailed filmographies for entertainment content.

name: Last.fm
description: Music discovery and social networking service that tracks listening habits, provides personalized recommendations, and connects users with similar musical tastes. Popular among music enthusiasts for discovering new artists.

name: Medium
description: Online publishing platform for articles, essays, and long-form content. Popular among writers, journalists, and thought leaders for sharing in-depth analysis and personal stories.

name: Reddit
description: Social news aggregation and discussion platform organized into topic-based communities called subreddits. Known for its voting system, diverse communities, and influence on internet culture.

name: Sluthate
description: Controversial forum focused on dating, relationships, and pickup culture. Known for hosting discussions about dating strategies and relationship dynamics, often with controversial viewpoints.

name: Stormfront
description: White supremacist forum and community that has been one of the internet's most prominent hate sites. Promotes racist ideology and serves as a gathering place for white nationalist movements.

name: Surespot
description: Encrypted messaging application designed for secure and private communication. Features end-to-end encryption and focuses on protecting user privacy and message security.

name: Techdirt
description: Technology news and policy discussion website covering digital rights, internet freedom, copyright issues, and tech policy. Known for its critical analysis of technology legislation and corporate practices.

name: TezukaInEnglish
description: Specialized forum dedicated to the works of Osamu Tezuka, the legendary manga creator known as the 'God of Manga.' Discusses his various series including Astro Boy, Black Jack, and Phoenix.

name: The West Australian
description: Major Australian newspaper and news website serving Western Australia. Covers local, national, and international news with a focus on Australian perspectives and regional issues.

name: Thought Catalog
description: Digital magazine and platform for personal essays, cultural commentary, and lifestyle content. Features millennial-focused writing on relationships, career, mental health, and contemporary culture.

name: Times of Israel
description: Israeli news website providing comprehensive coverage of Middle East affairs, Israeli politics, and Jewish community news worldwide. Offers multiple perspectives on regional conflicts and developments.

name: Twitter
description: Microblogging and social networking platform known for real-time news, political discourse, and viral content. Limited character count encourages concise communication and rapid information sharing.

name: VNN
description: Vanguard News Network - white nationalist website promoting antisemitic and racist content. Serves as a platform for extremist political views and hate speech targeting minority groups.

name: Wikipedia
description: Free online encyclopedia with collaborative editing, containing millions of articles on virtually every topic. One of the most visited websites globally and a primary source of information for internet users.

name: WordPress
description: Popular content management system and blogging platform powering millions of websites worldwide. Offers both hosted and self-hosted solutions for creating blogs, business sites, and online publications.

name: Wrong Planet
description: Online community and support forum for people with autism, Asperger's syndrome, and related conditions. Provides a safe space for discussion, advice, and connection among neurodivergent individuals.

name: YouTube
description: World's largest video sharing and streaming platform owned by Google. Hosts billions of videos ranging from entertainment and education to news and personal vlogs, fundamentally changing media consumption.

name: YTMND
description: You're The Man Now Dog - early internet meme website for creating simple multimedia pages combining images, text, and sound. Influential in early internet culture and meme development.
